Container.Name: nuvo-shim
Container.Overview: REST API and Server-Sent Events for Legrand Nuvo Player Portfolio zones (volume, mute, Line In, power). Host networking is required for SSDP discovery and UPnP event callbacks.

Config.Name: Zone IPs
Config.Description: Comma-separated zone IPs for unicast discovery (needed when the amp is on another VLAN)

Config.Name: Event callback port
Config.Description: TCP port the zones connect back to with state changes. Allow amp VLAN to this host on it.

Config.Name: Event callback IP
Config.Description: IP the zones should call back on. Leave blank to auto-detect.

Config.Name: API token
Config.Description: Optional bearer token for the API
